package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_depends_on_service_package: Repositories that import service packages, which inverts the expected dependency flow.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Subscription struct {
	ID     uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Plan   string `gorm:"size:64"`
	Active bool   `gorm:"default:true"`
}

type SubscriptionService struct {
	discountRate float64
}

func (s *SubscriptionService) CalculatePrice(plan string) float64 {
	base := map[string]float64{"basic": 9.99, "pro": 29.99, "enterprise": 99.99}
	price := base[plan]
	return price * (1 - s.discountRate)
}

type SubscriptionRepo struct {
	db             *gorm.DB
	pricingService *SubscriptionService
}

func NewSubscriptionRepo(db *gorm.DB, pricingService *SubscriptionService) *SubscriptionRepo {
	return &SubscriptionRepo{db: db, pricingService: pricingService}
}

func (r *SubscriptionRepo) Create(plan string) (*Subscription, error) {
	price := r.pricingService.CalculatePrice(plan)
	_ = price

	sub := &Subscription{Plan: plan, Active: true}
	err := r.db.Create(sub).Error
	return sub, err
}

var _ = gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
